notes:
I couldn't do this research this time, so I have no notes on Esther 6 to give you.

I used up my search allowance on the first try and got no results back. My attempt to open Guzik's Esther 6 commentary on enduringword.com directly was refused, because I can only open exact web addresses that came from you or from an earlier search. I did get into the Enduring Word homepage and its commentary index (https://enduringword.com/commentary/). But that page picks the book and chapter from dropdown menus and has no direct link to Esther 6, so I didn't find any commentary content.

Your rules say to report only what the pages actually say and never fill gaps from my own knowledge. So I haven't written any verse notes, because I'd have had to make them up.

**To get this done, either:**
1. **Ask me again in a new message.** My search allowance resets, and I'll start with focused searches (Esther 6 on Enduring Word, the Bible Hub/StudyLight commentaries by Gill, Ellicott and the Pulpit Commentary, Precept Austin, NET Bible notes, and Catholic/Orthodox sources). Then I'll read the pages those searches return.
2. **Paste the exact web addresses you want me to read** into your message, for example:
   - https://enduringword.com/bible-commentary/esther-6/
   - https://biblehub.com/commentaries/esther/6-1.htm (and the pages for the other verses)
   - https://www.preceptaustin.org/esther-6-commentary
   - https://netbible.org/bible/Esther+6

   If you give me the addresses, I can open them directly and write the verse-by-verse notes ("v. 1: …") with a link for every point.
